timeReferenceNote: Effective labeling time, estimated per group: about 1 min for a group with one distinct message, 2 min for up to 20 distinct messages, 4 min for more; HDFS about 1.5 / 2.5 / 3.5 min for 1 / 2-10 / more event orders. Range = 0.6x to 1.8x the typical value.
accuracyReferenceNote: Reference accuracy: the share of groups whose true label the Guide's rules give when they are applied exactly (group level, worked examples excluded).
